messages:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to publish the Redwood Optimize benchmark + product blog tomorrow at 09:00 PT. Embargoed until then. Need final signoffs and a press outreach plan. :rocket:
Maya: Thanks — can we get an embargoed press list? I can draft the email copy after legal signoff.
Ben: Timeline ok. Who owns Twitter/X thread and CEO quote?
Olivia: I can take the social thread. Will prep carousel and short demo clip. Need 16:9 30s clip by EOD.
Tariq: Legal just pinged me — want the benchmark appendix and methodology PDF uploaded to drive for review. Link?
Alex: Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/launch/opt-bench (embargo access set). Appendix in /methodology.
Maya: Drafting press email now, will paste here once Ben confirms quote.
Ben: Quick quote draft: "These results show how serving optimizations translate to lower cost and predictable latency at scale." Thoughts?
Olivia: Good start. Add a line about fallbacks and reliability. e.g., "and maintain availability with smart routing and fallback policies."
Ben: Updated: "These results show how serving optimizations translate to lower cost and predictable latency at scale, while preserving availability through smart routing and fallback policies."
Maya: Nice — I'll slot that in. PR ask: any embargo exceptions (local reporters we should pre-brief)?
Alex: One exception: TechEU reporter (Anna K) — we pre-briefed under NDA last week. Marked on the list.
Tariq: Legal done with methodology signoff — minor wording change in section 3.5, fixed.
press-bot: Automated: embargo_release scheduled for 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z, notify_channel=marketing, notify_list=secured.
Maya: Email draft (embargoed):
```
Hi {{first_name}},
We’re sharing an embargoed benchmark and product blog that compares cost/latency improvements for common LLM workloads. Please do not publish until 09:00 PT on 3/24. Key assets attached + embargoed link. Happy to set up briefings.
Best,
Maya (Redwood)
```
Olivia: Social plan (thread skeleton):
- Tweet 1: Headline + key result stat.
- Tweet 2: Short explainer gif.
- Tweet 3: Link to blog + CTA.
I’ll schedule using Buffer at T+0. Need final stat copy.
Alex: Key stat: "up to 3x lower per-token cost" — confirm that's accurate with eng.
Tariq: Eng confirms median cost reduction 2.8x on sample workloads. Use "up to 3x" is ok.
Maya: PR distribution list attached. Will send embargoed emails 30 minutes before publish so reporters can prep.
Ben: Who's on standby for any technical questions from press? Suggest Tariq + Elena from infra.
Tariq: I can be on call first hour. Elena looped in via DM.
Olivia: Uploaded 30s demo clip to drive /assets/video_30s.mp4 — still needs a tiny edit. Tagging @design for polish.
Maya: Final check: do we have an embargoed FAQ? It helps reduce follow-ups.
Alex: Put a quick FAQ in the drive; Maya will review.
press-bot: Automated: outreach_queue created (count=42), scheduled_send=2026-03-24T15:30:00Z.
Maya: Sending final embargo email in ~10 mins to approved list.
Ben: CEO availability for live Q&A? He can do 11:00 PT drop-in for top outlets if requested.
Alex: Good. Post-publish: create a brief internal readout in #launch-ops with link to coverage and spikes. Olivia — can you lead amplification?
Olivia: Yep. I'll coordinate owned channels and tag growth.
Tariq: Monitoring plan: set alerts on latency/cost dashboards, and a slack alert in #incidents if thresholds breach.
Alex: Perfect — thanks everyone. Keep this thread for final notes and any embargo slipups. :thumbsup:
